Two small loudspeakers are placed side by side $30 \text{ cm}$ apart.
They are connected to the same signal generator so that they emit sound of frequency $400 \text{ Hz}$ in phase with one another.
The sounds both reach a microphone placed $40 \text{ cm}$ directly in front of one of the two loudspeakers as shown.
What is the phase difference between waves from the loudspeakers as they arrive at the microphone?
